home.not_installed: The game is not installed yet.
home.ready: {version} is downloaded and starts next time
home.no_release: No game release is published yet.
home.offline_none: Offline. Go online once to download the game.
notes.crashed: The game crashed (exit code {code}). See Game output.
notes.update_failed: The update failed, the installed game stays: {error}
notes.migrated: Profiles are gone: the launcher now has one game folder. The settings and saves of {profile} were kept.
notes.migrated_left: The folders of other profiles stay where they were: {folders}
log.none: The game has not been started yet.
mods.none: No mods installed. Browse the index or import a zip.
mods.has_code_hint: This mod carries Wasm code. It runs inside the game's sandbox, but only enable mods you trust.
mods.installed_disabled: Installed {id}. It stays disabled until you enable it.
mods.enable_warning: Mods are made by other people. Enable only mods from sources you trust.
mods.declares_code: Runs code: {file} (Wasm, in the game's sandbox)
mods.remove_body: {name} is deleted from the mods folder.
problem.duplicate: Another mod has the same id; the game will refuse to start.
problem.unknown_keys: mod.json has keys the game refuses: {keys}
problem.incompatible: Made for game {range}, the installed game is {game}.
browse.no_index: No mod index is set up.
browse.pick: Pick a mod from the list.
browse.install_note: Downloads are checked against the index's SHA-256. New mods start disabled.
browse.no_fitting_version: No version fits the installed game.
settings.offline_hint: No update checks and no downloads; the installed game and the cached index only.
settings.relay_hint: Written to the game's settings as backend_url. Empty keeps the game's own.
settings.window_hint: Such as 1280x720. Empty for the game's default.
settings.extra_hint: Split like a shell does; quotes group words.
settings.indexes_hint: An index is one JSON file (docs/mod-index.md). The first index that lists a mod wins.
settings.dev_build_hint: For people who build castanea from source: run a checkout or build folder in place instead of the newest release.
settings.dev_build_set: In use: {folder}. Updates are off while it is set.
settings.token_hint: Only for a private game repository. Kept in a private file, never in launcher.json.
settings.token_from: A token is set ({origin}). Save an empty field to delete it.
about.text: Keeps castanea at its newest release, starts it, and manages and finds mods.
about.license: MIT licence. Built with egui. Text in Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1), icons from Phosphor (MIT).
about.key_pages: Open the pages in sidebar order
about.key_escape: Close a question, leave mod details
about.security_text: Downloads use HTTPS only and are checked against a SHA-256 from the release or the index; a build that fails the check is thrown away and the installed one stays. The launcher runs no downloaded code except the game. New mods start disabled; before enabling one you see what it declares.
